mechanism: Naltrexone blocks opioid receptors while phenelzine is an MAOI that increases monoamine levels; combined use risks serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and reduced efficacy of naltrexone in opioid-dependent patients.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, baseline monitoring, and dose adjustments with close patient supervision for serotonergic and hypertensive effects.
